{{Infobox character |games =FOTV |image =FOTV Scavengers front.png |image desc |race =[[Human]] |gender =Five men and one woman |family = |location =[[Filly]] |role =Scavengers |affiliation = |TV actor =See [[#Behind the scenes|below]] }} The '''scavengers''' are a group of denizens of [[Filly]] {{In|FOTV}}. ==Background== This group of six scavengers is led by [[Tom (TV series)|Tom]] and includes the [[Filly huge man|huge man]] and four others. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Head]]=== [[File:FOTV Scavengers.png|thumb|200px|Scavengers at work]] The scavengers find the unguarded power armor that [[Maximus]] left on the outskirts of Filly. When Maximus returns and tries to recover the armor, two scavengers run off, while four others (the leader named Tom, the huge man, a masked man, and a long-haired man) decide to fight him for it. After initially beating Maximus into the ground, the group loses interest in him, with Tom warning him not to contest them again. Maximus does not back down and instead picks up a wrench and a toilet seat as weapons, going back for round two. He beats the huge man and the masked man unconscious, but Tom and the other man grapple him against his power armor; however, Maximus manages to put his left arm inside the power armor, using it to hold and crush Tom's head, killing him. The long-haired man runs away in fright, leaving Maximus victorious. ==Appearances== The scavengers appear {{In|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|3=103}} ==Behind the scenes== [[Ethan Dubin]] plays [[Tom (TV series)|Scavenger Tom]]. The unnamed scavengers are portrayed by stunt performers [[Kevin Matthew McDonald]] ([[Filly huge man|huge man]]), [[Evan Dane Taylor]] (long-haired man), [[Travis Staton-Marrero]] (masked man), and two uncredited extras. ==Gallery== Scavenger Tom.png|[[Tom (TV series)|Scavenger Tom]]
